passage.text: Could I have a day off next Friday, June 20th?
passage.reading: kʊd aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈdeɪ ˈɔːf ˈnɛkst ˈfraɪdeɪ, ˈdʒuːn ˈtwɛntiəθ?

passage.text: I need the day for something personal.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈniːd ðə ˈdeɪ fər ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈpɜːrsənəl.

passage.text: My grandmother is moving to a new house, and she needs my help.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈɡrænmʌðər ɪz ˈmuːvɪŋ tu ə ˈnuː ˈhaʊs, ənd ʃiː ˈniːdz maɪ ˈhɛlp.

passage.text: I've already handed in my report, and Kate has agreed to do my tasks that day.
passage.reading: aɪv ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈhændɪd ˈɪn maɪ rɪˈpɔːrt, ənd ˈkeɪt hæz əˈɡriːd tə ˈduː maɪ ˈtæsks ðæt ˈdeɪ.

passage.text: Yes, you have my permission to take Friday off.
passage.reading: ˈjɛs, juː ˈhæv maɪ pərˈmɪʃən tə ˈteɪk ˈfraɪdeɪ ˈɔːf.

passage.text: Thank you for telling me early, and thanks for handing in your report on time.
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər ˈtɛlɪŋ miː ˈɜːrli, ənd ˈθæŋks fər ˈhændɪŋ ˈɪn jʊr rɪˈpɔːrt ɑːn ˈtaɪm.

passage.text: I agree with you: family comes first.
passage.reading: aɪ əˈɡriː wɪð juː: ˈfæməli ˈkʌmz ˈfɜːrst.

passage.text: I hope your grandmother likes her new house!
passage.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp jʊr ˈɡrænmʌðər ˈlaɪks hɜːr ˈnuː ˈhaʊs!
